bugs.what: Faction commitment tracked silently — asking reeve about the barrow locked me into sealing path with no explicit confirmation. Gray priest later said 'you have already given your word' but I only asked questions, never accepted aid.

confusions: Path choice system: unclear when/how I committed to reeve's sealing path vs priest's verses path — only discovered the lock when doors stopped opening
Elder's locked coffer: sat in Elder's House but never had interaction options to open or ask about it, despite notice board mentioning it held something taken from the king
Option 4 'kneel and take his crown (surrender)' appeared at the throne but was never explained — unclear what outcome this would trigger
suggestions: Add explicit confirmation dialog when committing to a faction path (e.g., 'Will you accept the watch's aid?')
Make locked containers interactive — let player attempt to open the coffer, or add dialogue asking the elder about it
Clarify what the surrender/crown option does, either through NPC dialogue or UI hints before choosing it
Add UI indicator showing current faction/path status to reduce confusion about which timeline you're in
